feature.text: When Christ is your life, you're not smaller, you're safer.

lines.text: Jesus isn't sitting down at the right hand of God because what he did here on this earth was really difficult and he needed to take a rest and take a break. That's not why he's sitting down. He's seated because now he is reigning.

The person who sets their mind on Christ is a person who can actually love the people right in front of them, who don't ignore the people in their lives but actually love them, because he isn't trying to invest his whole life into them.
When Christ is your life, you're not smaller, you're safer.
As long as Christ lives, guess what? So will you. As long as Christ lives, you will live, and he is never going to die again.
And Paul says this about your life, it is kept with Christ in God. And for anything to get to it, it would have to get through God. It would have to get through Christ.
So rather than calling it the way that we normally do with, well, we're just really busy, or we think practically, or this is just how life is, we need to name it for what it really is. It's sin.
